vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/fus.fused_moe_kernel_gptq_awq:
pid = tl.program_id(axis=0)
num_pid_m = tl.cdiv(EM, BLOCK_SIZE_M)
num_pid_n = tl.cdiv(N, BLOCK_SIZE_N)
num_pid_in_group = GROUP_SIZE_M * num_pid_n
group_id = pid // num_pid_in_group
first_pid_m = group_id * GROUP_SIZE_M
group_size_m = min(num_pid_m - first_pid_m, GROUP_SIZE_M)
pid_m = first_pid_m + ((pid % num_pid_in_group) % group_size_m)
pid_n = (pid % num_pid_in_group) // group_size_m

num_tokens_post_padded = tl.load(num_tokens_post_padded_ptr)
if pid_m * BLOCK_SIZE_M >= num_tokens_post_padded:
    return

offs_token_id = pid_m * BLOCK_SIZE_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_M).to(tl.int64)
offs_token = tl.load(sorted_token_ids_ptr + offs_token_id)
token_mask = offs_token < num_valid_tokens

offs_bn = pid_n * BLOCK_SIZE_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_N).to(tl.int64)
offs_k = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_K)

a_ptrs = a_ptr + (offs_token[:, None] // top_k * stride_am + offs_k[None, :] * stride_ak)

off_experts = tl.load(expert_ids_ptr + pid_m).to(tl.int64)

accumulator = tl.zeros((BLOCK_SIZE_M, BLOCK_SIZE_N), dtype=tl.float32)

pack_factor = 2 if use_int4_w4a16 else 1
num_k_blocks = tl.cdiv(K, BLOCK_SIZE_K)

for k_blk in range(0, num_k_blocks):
    k_start = k_blk * BLOCK_SIZE_K
    offs_k_iter = k_start + offs_k
    k_mask = offs_k_iter < K

    a = tl.load(
        a_ptr + (offs_token[:, None] // top_k * stride_am + offs_k_iter[None, :] * stride_ak),
        mask=token_mask[:, None] & k_mask[None, :],
        other=0.0,
    )

    if use_int4_w4a16:
        offs_k_packed = offs_k_iter // 2
        b_ptrs = b_ptr + off_experts * stride_be + (offs_k_packed[:, None] * stride_bk + offs_bn[None, :] * stride_bn)
        b_packed = tl.load(
            b_ptrs,
            mask=k_mask[:, None] & (offs_bn[None, :] < N),
            other=0,
        )
        low = b_packed & 0xF
        high = (b_packed >> 4) & 0xF
        b = tl.where((offs_k_iter[:, None] & 1) == 0, low, high).to(tl.float32)
    else:
        b_ptrs = b_ptr + off_experts * stride_be + (offs_k_iter[:, None] * stride_bk + offs_bn[None, :] * stride_bn)
        b = tl.load(
            b_ptrs,
            mask=k_mask[:, None] & (offs_bn[None, :] < N),
            other=0,
        ).to(tl.float32)

    g_idx = offs_k_iter // group_size
    b_scale_ptrs = b_scale_ptr + off_experts * stride_bse + (g_idx[:, None] * stride_bsk + offs_bn[None, :] * stride_bsn)
    b_scale = tl.load(
        b_scale_ptrs,
        mask=k_mask[:, None] & (offs_bn[None, :] < N),
        other=0.0,
    ).to(tl.float32)

    if has_zp:
        if use_int4_w4a16:
            offs_bn_zp = offs_bn // 2
            b_zp_ptrs = b_zp_ptr + off_experts * stride_bze + (g_idx[:, None] * stride_bzk + offs_bn_zp[None, :] * stride_bzn)
            zp_packed = tl.load(
                b_zp_ptrs,
                mask=k_mask[:, None] & (offs_bn[None, :] < N),
                other=0,
            )
            zp_low = zp_packed & 0xF
            zp_high = (zp_packed >> 4) & 0xF
            zp = tl.where((offs_bn[None, :] & 1) == 0, zp_low, zp_high).to(tl.float32)
        else:
            b_zp_ptrs = b_zp_ptr + off_experts * stride_bze + (g_idx[:, None] * stride_bzk + offs_bn[None, :] * stride_bzn)
            zp = tl.load(
                b_zp_ptrs,
                mask=k_mask[:, None] & (offs_bn[None, :] < N),
                other=0,
            ).to(tl.float32)
        b = (b - zp) * b_scale
    else:
        b = b * b_scale

    accumulator += tl.dot(a.to(compute_type), b.to(compute_type))

if MUL_ROUTED_WEIGHT:
    moe_weight = tl.load(topk_weights_ptr + offs_token, mask=token_mask, other=0)
    accumulator = accumulator * moe_weight[:, None]

accumulator = accumulator.to(compute_type)

offs_cn = offs_bn
c_ptrs = c_ptr + stride_cm * offs_token[:, None] + stride_cn * offs_cn[None, :]
c_mask = token_mask[:, None] & (offs_cn[None, :] < N)
tl.store(c_ptrs, accumulator, mask=c_mask)
